## FAQ

Is this drive compatible with my system?

This drive is designed to work perfectly in a PlayStation 5 console. Otherwise, you must have a motherboard with an available M.2 socket that supports a NVMe drive. It may be possible to use an enclosure or adapter, but NVMe boot support on older systems is not guaranteed. This drive is backward compatible with PCIe 3.0 and 2.0 even with fewer than four lanes, but will be bandwidth-limited.

What is the warranty for this drive?

1 year or 5 years with registration. Endurance is rated at 700TBW for the 1TB SKU.

What's the hardware on the SSD?

This drive utilizes Phison's E18 controller with DRAM, along with 96-layer or newer TLC.

...

Carol Ryan 

Plug and play for PS5!!

This was very easy to install and worked perfectly after the first format. Speed is as advertised for the 1TB and the space is a true 1TB available.

...

Main selling point

The main reason I got this one was because not only did it already come with a heart sink, the heat sink served a dual purpose of also being the bay cover. Technically making it a more effective cooler than just a basic heat sink. The thing is I was stuck at a crossroads which the 1 TB version was not enough for all the games I intend to put on it but for the price of the 2 TB version, I could buy a 2nd PS5. Something to think about if you plan to put a lot of games on it.
